name: Inclusive Therapists
one_liner: A directory of identity-affirming therapists, counsellors and coaches, searchable by identity, sliding scale and virtual care.
best_for: People from marginalised communities who want an identity-affirming provider
People looking for sliding-scale or low-cost options
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want the service itself to provide or bill therapy
People who want only licensed clinicians without checking each listing (coaches are also listed)
short_description: Directory of social-justice-oriented therapists and other providers. Free to search; you pay the provider you choose at their rates.
long_description: Inclusive Therapists is a directory, not a therapy provider. It lists therapists, counsellors, coaches and other mental health providers who say they are committed to racial, 2SLGBTQIA+, neurodivergence and disability justice, and each provider goes through its verification process before being listed. You can search by identity, location, focus, virtual sessions and sliding-scale or low-cost options, and there is also a Get Matched service. Providers operate independently and are not affiliated with Inclusive Therapists, so fees, insurance and sliding-scale terms are set by each provider and paid to them directly. The directory lists providers in the US, including US territories, and Canada.
patient_summary: You search Inclusive Therapists for an affirming provider by identity, location, focus or sliding-scale options, or use its Get Matched service, then contact the provider yourself. Fees, insurance and sliding-scale terms are set by each provider and paid to them directly. Listings include coaches as well as licensed therapists, so check a provider's licence.

pricing.starting_price: Free to search; therapists set their own fees
pricing.notes: Searching is free for people seeking care; providers pay for membership. Each provider sets its own fees, insurance and sliding-scale terms and is paid directly. Whether the Get Matched service has a fee was not confirmed.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says member and match-request information will never be sold, is shared only with matched professionals and service providers barred from other uses, and describes no advertising sharing; match data is removed within 90 days, but no right to request deletion is stated.

seo.title: Inclusive Therapists: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Inclusive Therapists is a directory of identity-affirming, social-justice-oriented therapists, searchable by race, identity, faith, sliding scale and more.

faqs.q: How much does Inclusive Therapists cost?
faqs.a: Free to search; therapists set their own fees. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Inclusive Therapists before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Inclusive Therapists replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Inclusive Therapists connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Inclusive Therapists?
faqs.a: Inclusive Therapists is available on the web.
Identity-based filters; Sliding-scale filter; Virtual sessions; Matching service.

availability.note: Providers in the US (including territories) and Canada. Independent providers; availability depends on your location.
